invariant: Never expose incomplete or corrupted data as valid committed data.

policy: Remain at or below 100 mA before configuration.
Do not start a payload mutation until configuration 1 is active and Task 3 reports power safe.
Keep actual configured input draw at or below the 300 mA descriptor declaration and below the physical protection limit.
Treat descriptor values and calculated budgets as design limits, not measurements.

reset_suspend_detach_policy: Reject new storage requests outside SERVICE_READY.
Return to enumeration on USB bus reset.
Block new storage requests while suspended.
Drop transport readiness on detach without replaying an interrupted mutation.
Do not convert an unknown storage outcome into success.

recovery_contract.reason: Proto-0 must not expose an unauthenticated remote firmware-update path before identity, protocol and update policy are frozen.

evidence_claims.FACT: The cited primary specifications and manufacturer pages define the USB-C sink termination, RP2350 USB routing, selected connector and protection candidates.
evidence_claims.DECISION: Proto-0 is one bus-powered USB 2.0 full-speed CDC-ACM device with independent CC pull-downs, no PD and physical-only recovery.
evidence_claims.EXPECTED: The selected topology and owner boundary are expected to enumerate without bypassing PAYLOAD_STORAGE_SERVICE after schematic capture, firmware binding and physical validation.
evidence_claims.UNKNOWN: Native ERC, PCB routing, impedance, ESD and EMC behavior, attach inrush, pre-configuration and suspend current, enumeration, endpoint behavior, host compatibility and physical recovery.

blocking_validation: allocate production VID and PID before external distribution
capture J1, both CC pull-downs, data ESD and VBUS ESD in editable KiCad source
run native KiCad ERC and independent connector pinout review
route and review the 90 ohm USB differential pair with a continuous ground reference
bind the policy owner to the RP2354A USB device controller and TinyUSB or an equivalent reviewed stack
freeze and regression-test emitted descriptors byte for byte
measure attach inrush and pre-configuration current at both cable orientations
measure configured and suspend current against the declared limits
capture D+ and D- enumeration and sustained-transfer waveforms
run enumeration, reset, suspend, resume and detach tests on supported hosts
inject detach, reset and suspend during every storage operation
complete Task 6 sourcing, derating and footprint verification
